info.name: DocuDesk
info.summary: Document anonymization and metadata enhancement for Nextcloud
info.description:
Document anonymization and metadata enhancement app for Nextcloud
DocuDesk provides services for anonymizing documents and enhancing metadata in a GDPR-compliant manner. It integrates with OpenRegister for document storage and text extraction.
## Key Features
- 🔒 GDPR-compliant document anonymization using Presidio - 📊 Document metadata extraction and enhancement - 🔍 Entity detection and PII removal - 📝 Configurable anonymization rules - 🔄 Integration with OpenRegister for document storage
**OpenRegister is required for this app to work**
Requirements can be found [here](https://conduction.gitbook.io/docudesk-nextcloud/installatie)
The Roadmap is available [here](https://github.com/orgs/docudesk/projects/1/views/2)
Create a [bug report](https://github.com/docudesk/.github/issues/new/choose)
Create a [feature request](https://github.com/docudesk/.github/issues/new/choose)
